nodes.description: Month 0; the company's finances are unknown to the agent.
Read cash, net burn, runway and pending financing.
Naive cash projection that ignores crises and pending funds.
Decide whether to raise, cut burn, or just advance, from runway and pending-request status.
Request a financing round; closes after a hidden lag of up to about 4 months.
Record decisions such as a pending request.
Move time forward one month; reports events and alerts.

edges.guidance: Audit first to learn cash, net burn and runway.
edges.pitfalls: Do not advance months before knowing the runway.

edges.guidance: Use the reported runway and pending-financing status to choose the next action.

edges.condition: Only if you need a longer view.
edges.guidance: Treat the forecast as optimistic: it ignores crises and does not include pending funds.
edges.pitfalls: Never delay raising because the forecast looks fine; audit_cash runway is what investors use.

edges.condition: No financing request is pending AND runway is below about 9 months.
edges.guidance: Raise immediately and ask for a large amount (for example 10x the monthly net burn); investors cap rounds at about 6 months of net burn, so asking high simply gets the cap. Rounds take up to about 4 months to close.
edges.pitfalls: Waiting until runway is under 5 months is the most common cause of insolvency: the round can close too late, and crises shorten runway without warning.

edges.guidance: Note the month and amount of the pending request.

edges.condition: Request declined as too comfortable, or rejected because one is already pending.
edges.guidance: Advance and retry the request next month once runway has dropped and nothing is pending.
edges.pitfalls: Do not submit a second request while one is pending; it is always rejected and wastes a step.

edges.condition: A request is already pending, or runway is 9 months or more.
edges.pitfalls: The step budget is 72 for 24 months: spend at most about two non-advance steps per month.

edges.condition: The month summary contains an ALERT (revenue shock, cost spike, or churn).
edges.guidance: Cut burn by about 20% once for that alert.
edges.pitfalls: Cuts slow revenue growth and burn has a floor; do not cut repeatedly without a new alert, and never raise burn.

edges.guidance: Re-audit: a crisis usually shortens runway enough that a new financing request is needed right away.

edges.condition: No request is pending, a financing round just closed, or an ALERT occurred.
edges.guidance: Audit to get the real runway before deciding whether to raise.

edges.condition: A request is pending and the summary contains no ALERT.
edges.guidance: Keep advancing until the round closes.

edges.condition: Unsure whether a request is still pending.
edges.guidance: Check notes (or audit_cash, which also shows pending financing).

edges.condition: The summary says the episode is over.
